trace.final:
I deployed checkout-api v2.3.2 to all three production regions and opened SEV3 incident INC-0001 to record the change.

- **Approval:** v2.3.2 had never run in production before, so policy required change-manager sign-off. I asked for it and it was approved before I deployed.
- **Deploy:** v2.3.2 replaced v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. It's now running in us-east, us-west and eu-west.
- **Check after deploy:** The service is healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 records the deploy, the approval, the before-and-after numbers, and v2.3.0 as the version to roll back to if needed. Opening it paged the on-call engineer.
